summary: Armour Residential REIT filed an 8-K to report a routine at-the-market (ATM) equity offering amendment. The company increased the number of common shares available for sale under its existing equity distribution agreement by 25 million. This is a capital-raising activity, not a transformative special situation. Multiple prior amendments to the same agreement are disclosed. No price, premium, or recommendation is provided. The filing lacks any catalyst such as a takeover, activist campaign, spinoff, or restructuring. Accordingly, this filing does not meet the criteria for a special-situation category.
